Title: 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy)
Volume: 19
Author: 蛭田達也 (Tatsuya Hiruta)
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Comics)
Language: Traditional Chinese
ISBN: 957-34-0175-4
Format: Paperback
Price printed on back: NT$60 / HK$25 / US$3
Condition: Very Good — light shelf wear, no major creases or tears. Cover art remains bright and vivid, with clean, intact pages.
Edition: Official licensed Chinese edition (正式授權中文版 / 少年系列)
🖼️ Description:
This is Volume 19 of Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒), a martial arts manga classic written and illustrated by Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也). Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this traditional Chinese version captures the dynamic action and humor that made the series a long-running favorite among fans of martial arts and shōnen manga.
The cover features the protagonist in an intense battle stance, surrounded by dramatic supporting characters, reflecting the volume’s high-stakes action and bold art style.
